verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own API reference browser for scanning endpoints, request fields, and response fields, plus per-endpoint docs such as POST /batch/subscribers and GET /fetch/search. Runnable calls come from a first-party Postman Collection covering every endpoint, but that runs in an external tool rather than inside the reference itself. Missing for 10: evidence of in-browser try-it/runnable examples in the reference, explicit interactivity beyond browsing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
